notes: The 1970 volume of the Recreation and Park Commission. Curated: contracts and design approvals, a gift of plants, the Coit Tower road.

coverage.remaining: Routine items not curated. Not placed: Germano Milono engaged for a new Senior Citizens' Center in Golden Gate Park (Apr 9, Res 8300; site not given), the Recreation Center for the Handicapped site at the Ida Smith Girl Scout camp (Nov 12, Hertzka & Knowles; no page), St. Francis Yacht Club alterations by Andersen and Palmer (Jun 25; no page), the move to rename Candlestick Park for Lefty O'Doul (May 14), Candlestick expansion (John Bolles).
coverage.note: Dated by meeting openers ("The Four Hundred ... Regular Meeting"); footers sometimes lag a meeting. Curated list F1970.py.

findings.address_as_written: Little Theater within the Palace of Fine Arts
findings.description: The Recreation and Park Commission approved Vincent Raney's final plans and specifications for the little theater inside the Palace of Fine Arts, adding an alternate to rebuild or repair the part of the Palace roof over it. In February it had approved his preliminary plans, subject to the state parks division, and accepted Walter S. Johnson's gift of $250,000 toward the theater.

citation.label: Minutes of the Recreation and Park Commission, April 9, 1970
